title: Write default .agent/PROMPT.md loop instructions
description: Create the default PROMPT.md template that instructs the AI agent on how to behave during rocket loop sessions. Must define the exit tag protocol (<complete>, <blocked>, <decide>).
acceptanceCriteria: Instructions for <blocked> tag with reason are present
Instructions for <decide> tag with question are present
File instructs the AI to read the PRD and focus on the current task

steps.details: In src/lib/agent-init.ts, set the PROMPT.md content. The prompt should instruct the AI to: (1) Read .agent/prd/PRD.md for project context, (2) Focus on implementing the current task completely, (3) Output <complete> when the task is done, (4) Output <blocked>reason for blockage</blocked> if stuck and need human help, (5) Output <decide>question requiring decision</decide> if a design choice is needed.

steps.description: Include code quality guidelines in PROMPT.md
steps.details: Add instructions: write tests, avoid over-engineering, handle errors gracefully, commit changes when a logical unit of work is complete.
After scaffolding a test project, open .agent/PROMPT.md and confirm it contains all three exit tag instructions.

technicalNotes: The PROMPT.md is prepended to the AI prompt in each loop iteration — keep it concise but comprehensive
The <complete>, <blocked>, and <decide> tags must be detectable by the tags.ts parser (TASK-53)
